<p>
	Every member of our kitchen team, including our kitchen porters, has completed Level 2 Food Safety and Hygiene for Catering. Within three weeks of the inspection we replaced the wash hand basin, repaired the floor and renewed all fridge and freezer seals. We are also introducing a digital system that records every daily food safety check. We have asked the council to re-inspect and look forward to showing them the improvements. This site held a 5 rating before this inspection.</p>
